address: Monterey Place near Highway 90 and Mustang Road

facts.value: The town invites sealed cash bids for a dedicated, undeveloped right-of-way.
Use the town’s sealed bid instructions. The as-is sale is subject to Town Council approval.
Monterey Place is labeled on the amended plat in Book 12, page 51C. The town notice identifies adjacent parcel numbers separately.

title: Monterey Place (Huachuca City sealed-bid land sale)
